gaps.sentence: She was appointed ___ managing director at just thirty-four.
gaps.explanation: After 'appoint/elect/name + unique role' no article is used.

gaps.sentence: He was offered ___ job in the human resources department.
gaps.explanation: 'A job' — first mention of one of many possible jobs. Note: 'in human resources' takes no article.

gaps.sentence: They organized ___ charity concert for flood victims.
gaps.explanation: 'A charity concert' — one of many possible concerts, first mention.

gaps.sentence: He joined ___ army when he was eighteen.
gaps.explanation: Institutions take 'the': the army, the police, the church.

gaps.sentence: She was wearing ___ old denim jacket that I loved at first sight.
gaps.explanation: 'An old…' — 'old' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: ___ spaceship travelled for six months before reaching Mars.
gaps.explanation: The spaceship — the one in the story; Mars takes no article.

gaps.sentence: She works as ___ waitress during the summer holidays.
gaps.explanation: After 'as' and 'work as', jobs take a/an: work as a waitress.
